subtitle: Lesson 9 · A worked scenario, start to finish

code:
3 Incidents, 3 users, 1 week
  symptom: intermittent VPN disconnect, ~45-60 min interval
  each triaged individually, each looks minor on its own
  3rd report in 4 days -> the pattern is now obvious
caption: No single Incident looked like an outage.

steps.label: Create
steps.sub: new Problem record, state New, short description names the pattern

steps.label: Link
steps.sub: all 3 Incidents get problem_id set to this Problem

steps.label: Investigate
steps.sub: state moves to Root Cause Analysis, cause_notes builds incrementally

code:
Note 1: correlates with concentrator load at peak login
Note 2: rules out individual devices (different laptops/ISPs)
Note 3: narrows to concentrator's session-timeout setting
caption: A journal, not a single final verdict.

eyebrow: Step 4 · Known Error, before the fix exists
code:
Cause confirmed: concentrator session-timeout setting
Permanent fix: requires a scheduled Change (Chapter 3)
  -> Problem flagged Known Error
  -> workaround documented, separate from cause_notes
caption: Known, but not yet fixed.

code:
Agent finds the Known Error via search
  applies the documented workaround
  links problem_id to the same Problem
  resolves the Incident fast -- no re-investigation
Problem itself: still Known Error, not Resolved
caption: The workaround moves fast; the real fix still doesn't exist yet.
